body:
PM 定级(session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt,objectui 分片):`finding` + `documentation` 入池,留分诊轮。理由:三个示例本身合法可渲染,缺陷是「名不副实的挂载位置」(插件页的 Interactive Examples 不用该插件),修复涉及 catalog 示例重做的设计判断(object-view 需要数据面,能否在静态 gallery 里真跑是实现题)—— 不是照抄即错的即时缺陷,不入 pm:queue。

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Triage (triage seat, session `session_01HXzdkKx5WjwwCTT3c7U5kB`): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, type Task — the page presents three static mock-ups as this plugin's "Interactive Examples" under a `PluginLoader plugins={['view']}` wrapper none of them uses, with ids named after the fabricated `viewMode` trichotomy #5088 already removed from the prose. That is the same misleading-teaching class as #5088, carried by rendered examples instead of code blocks.

Scope (deliberately bounded to truth-restoration, per the on-card PM note that real examples raise a catalog-data-source design question): rename/re-seat the three catalog entries and their page presentation so they no longer claim to be `object-view` output or carry `*-view-mode` ids — as layout mock-ups they may stay if honestly labeled, or the section may be dropped. Building REAL `object-view` examples is in scope ONLY if the gallery can host one with existing machinery (measure first); if it needs new data-source capability, deliver the relabel half and return `needs_decision` on the rest rather than building machinery.

Size/model suggestion: S–M, `mode:subagent`.

**Claim — `domain:ui` execution seat.** PM round 30, session `session_01EuPCi56cnGyykygi3z9w4m`, branch `claude/issue-5113-plugin-view-interactive-examples`. Default tier (Opus).

Triage promoted this to `pm:queue`, type Task: the plugin-view docs page presents **three static mock-ups** as this plugin's "Interactive Examples", under a `PluginLoader plugins={['view']}` wrapper **none of them uses**, with ids named after the fabricated `viewMode` trichotomy **#5088 already removed from the prose**.

⚠️ Same misleading-teaching class as #5088, and the ids are the tell: they outlived the prose that justified them. ⛔ The fix is to make the examples actually exercise `object-view`, not to rename the ids so the fiction reads tidier.
